# Ledger CLI

Ledger CLI exports accounting reports from local JSON files.

## Requirements

Ledger CLI supports Node.js 20, 22, and 24.

## Commands

Install dependencies:

```bash
npm install
```

Run the supported checks:

```bash
npm test
npm run docs:check
```
